hook.head: 3 Claude Code features most people never use.
hook.vo: Three Claude Code features... that most people never use.

tips.n: Number one. Claude dot M D.
tips.vo: Put a file called Claude dot M D in your project. Claude reads it at the start of every session, so it remembers your rules, and how you like things done.
tips.head: CLAUDE.md = memory.

tips.vo: Press Shift Tab to switch into plan mode. Claude reads your code and writes a plan first... and changes nothing until you approve it.
tips.head: Plan before it touches code.

visual.prompt: > add a booking page to my site

tips.vo: A skill is a folder with a skill dot M D file inside. Write your process once, and Claude follows it every single time that task comes up.
tips.head: Teach it once. It follows forever.

cta.head: Save this for later.
cta.vo: Save this for later... and follow Pixel and Co, for more.
